title: A linear objective is best at a corner
lede: The solid is every point that satisfies a handful of linear inequalities. The two direction sliders choose what to maximize. The plane perpendicular to that direction is pushed until it touches the solid.
notice: With the plane pushed to 1, it touches the solid at a single corner, shown larger. That corner has the largest value of the objective.
Turn the direction slowly and the optimal corner stays put, then jumps to a neighboring corner. It never moves to the middle of a face.
If the direction is exactly perpendicular to a face, a whole edge or face ties, and the readout says so.
hint: Drag to rotate. Move the direction sliders and watch the optimal corner.
